title: Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9)
system: Chemical Pipe Fittings & Flow Control Components
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9) where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for 90-degree seamless long radius elbow requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by 90-degree seamless long radius elbow and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance at 200W fiber laser
TIG welding Grade 2 at 200W fiber laser
Hydrostatic shell test at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for 90degree seamless long application
inspection: Bubble leak vacuum box (90degree seamless verified)
commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment — critical for 90degree seamless long performance

faq.q: What facing standards are available for Elbow / 90 deg bend flanged connections?
faq.a: Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9) flanged connections can be supplied with raised face (RF), flat face (FF), ring-type joint (RTJ), or male-female (M/F) facings per ASME B16.5. Surface finish 125-250 µin Ra for RF facings. For 90degree seamless long, RTJ or M/F facings are recommended to eliminate potential leak paths in toxic or flammable chemical service.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9) orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Long Radius Elbow (ASME B16.9) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for 90degree seamless long.
